palindrome: Able was I ere I saw Elba. Was it a car or a cat I saw? No 'x' in Nixon. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama. Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam. Never odd or even. Was it a rat I saw? Rats live on no evil star. Step on no pets. How ere I saw Elba! Go hang a salami, I'm a lasagna hog! Able was I saw Elba.
